propositions: The live tickets branch .bridge_state/projects.json was overwritten with rehearsal fixture keys (LEG/ONE/TWO/ZERO) that do not exist in live REB Jira Cloud.

The Reconcile Bridge scheduled GitHub Action fails every run since 2026-08-15T02:39Z when fetcher._build_snapshot iterates over the corrupted projects.json keys and issues JQL query 'project = LEG AND status != "Done"', which Jira rejects with 'the value leg does not exist for the field project' and ACLI exits with code 1.
The corruption was introduced by ad-hoc git commits (9f1b2cff98, 275bd7507e) authored by the test-fixture git identity at 2026-08-14T19:18-0700, 21 minutes before the first observed failure.
The known-good canonical state is {"version": 1, "legacy_default": "REB", "projects": {}} (empty projects map), which causes the fan-out to safely fall back to the single configured project REB.

The bridge-state write path (projects_store.set_project/remove_project) lacks write locking, auto-commit, and auto-publish, enabling ad-hoc hand-commits that violate the store concurrency invariant documented in docs/concurrency.md.
